title: 第15章 属性面板上线第16章 灵泉与洞府
lines: 次日清晨。
当剑斩红尘、琉璃仙梦、莽穿地球三人刚一上线。
眼前便同时弹出了一个熟悉的半透明提示框。
【《修仙OL》V0.12版本热更新公告】：
亲爱的玩家，为优化游戏体验，我们已于本次更新中加装【基础属性面板】功能模块。
您现在可通过意念呼唤“属性”
或“状态”
来查看自身基础属性。
此面板将更直观地展示您的角色成长，助力您的仙途之旅。
更多功能将持续更新，感谢您的支持与理解。
——开发团队敬上。
“游戏更新了，是属性面板！”
莽穿地球率先喊出声，语气里满是惊喜。
“总算来了，快看看！”
琉璃仙梦也迫不及待地附和
之前全靠感觉猜测自己身体强弱的日子可算到头了。
就连一向比较冷静的剑斩红尘，眼中也闪过一丝急切。
他可太想知道，自己这具被调侃为“非酋”
的身体，数据究竟有多惨淡了。
三人几乎是同时唤出了自己的属性面板。
面板设计极为简洁，仅有三项核心数据：
体魄：关联体力、耐力、生命力与恢复速度等。
根骨：关联力量、敏捷、身体强度与协调性等。
神念：关联精神、意志、感知力与潜在灵力容量等。
面板下方还附有两行小字注释
其中一行是。
【普通健康成年凡人各项属性平均值约为1点，凡人极限值约为10点（少数情况为15，极少数情况还能继续提升），当前版本暂无法探测灵根资质。
“平均值是1，极限10？”
剑斩红尘喃喃自语，立刻看向自己的面板。
【剑斩红尘】
content_en:
Early next morning.
Dang Jian Zhan Hongchen, Liuli Xianmeng, and Mang Chuan Earth have just come online.
A familiar translucent prompt box popped up in front of me.
["Xiu Xian OL" V0.12 version hot update announcement]:
Dear players, in order to optimize the game experience, we have added the [Basic Attribute Panel] function module in this update.
You can now call "attributes" with your mind
or "status"
to view its own basic attributes.
This panel will more intuitively display the growth of your character and help you on your journey to immortality.
More features will be continuously updated, thank you for your support and understanding.
——Sincerely, the development team.
"The game has been updated, it's the attribute panel!"
Mangchuan Earth was the first to shout, his tone full of surprise.
"Finally here, take a look!"
Liuli Xianmeng couldn’t wait to agree
The days of guessing one's physical strength based solely on feeling were over.
Even Jian Zhan Hongchen, who had always been relatively calm, had a flash of eagerness in his eyes.
He really wanted to know that his body was ridiculed as a "non-chief"
body, how bleak the data is.
The three of them called up their attribute panels almost at the same time.
The panel design is extremely simple, with only three core data:
Physique: related to physical strength, endurance, vitality, recovery speed, etc.
Root bone: related to strength, agility, physical strength and coordination, etc.
Divine thoughts: related to spirit, will, perception and potential spiritual capacity, etc.
There are also two lines of small print comments below the panel.
One of the lines is.
[The average value of various attributes of an ordinary healthy adult mortal is about 1 point, and the limit value of a mortal is about 10 points (in a few cases it is 15, and in rare cases it can continue to increase). The current version cannot detect spiritual root qualifications.
"The average is 1 and the limit is 10?"
Jianzhan Hongchen murmured to himself and immediately looked at his panel.
[Sword cuts through the world of mortals]
Physique: 0.7
Root bone: 0.8
title_en: Chapter 15 Attribute Panel is online Chapter 16 Spiritual Spring and Cave Mansion
